skills.name: read-and-search-books
skills.description: Discover, fetch, search, and cite passages from Đường Đến Niết-bàn (Nibbānagāminipaṭipadā) by Pa-Auk Tawya Sayadaw across both the 5-volume Complete Edition (Bộ Đại, Vietnamese) and 9-volume Abridged Edition (Bộ Tóm Lược / Mini, Vietnamese and English) on nibbanagamini.org.
